decisions.reason: A height-adjustable executive desk fits the firm's core office and conference business and the lasting demand for representative, flexible workplaces.
A chair family close to the established offer is a durable catalogue staple that premium furniture makers typically keep for many years.
Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche accessory and more exposed to range pruning, but they cost little to keep and complement the rug and lounge offer.
A designer sofa by a prominent studio (EOOS) close to the core living range is a flagship-type product the firm would keep.
A high standing table supports flexible workplace and lounge settings and sits close to the established offer.
The rug collection is distant from the core business, but it rounds out complete interior solutions and is still actively presented.
